items.corrections: Opened Federal Reserve author-institution abstract establishes the historical equity-premium puzzle. It neither gives the desired coherent solution nor establishes present consensus or impact.
One AEA paper constructs a heterogeneous-agent model and shows aggregation can require implausible representative-agent preferences; the complete predictive framework remains aspirational.
The claim-relevant primary source pages were located but blocked or unreadable establishing a coherent aggregate-capital theory resolving reswitching or the controversy.
A 2026 economic-history paper quantifies growth divergence and compares innovation, institutions and geography, while explicitly distinguishing proximate from ultimate causes.
A 2024 article documents the persistent saving-investment correlation and proposes a goods-market-friction account of the Feldstein–Horioka finding.
A 2021 JPE model reports accounting for several major exchange-rate puzzles, including PPP and exchange-rate disconnect.
A Federal Reserve paper estimates its New-Keynesian search model accounts for roughly one-third, possibly 60%, of labor-market-tightness fluctuations.

Original IMF PDF failed independent reopen (404), alternate was 403. Opened Bank of England discussion supports money creation and funding mechanics; no complete crisis-proof regulatory design is evidenced.

Relevant primary pages were located but were inaccessible, so the claimed result could not be assessed from them a practical, comprehensive, non-dictatorial welfare function satisfying the proposed real-world requirements; located theorem pages were inaccessible.

The located primary page was inaccessible, so the full claim could not be assessed a general scalable mechanism that simultaneously elicits truth and efficient voluntary contributions to global public goods; the located candidate page was inaccessible.
